documents.body: European regulators have granted approval for Cabteza, a long-acting injectable medication for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) against HIV. Rollout across European Union member states is anticipated to begin by mid-year, pending national implementation plans. Health officials hope the new option will increase uptake and improve adherence to HIV prevention strategies.

documents.title: Lost Poems of Polish Romantic Poet Unearthed in Vienna
documents.body: A previously unknown manuscript containing dozens of poems by the 19th-century Polish poet, Julian Królikowski, has been discovered in the Austrian National Library’s archives. The collection, believed to have been smuggled out of Poland during a period of political upheaval, offers new insight into the poet’s views on nationalism and artistic expression. Experts are hailing the find as a significant contribution to Polish literary history, prompting calls for its digitization and public exhibition. Initial analysis suggests several poems were written during his exile years.
